rationale: v1.80.1 already exposes the unconditional information-card Edit button, lazy marker-dialog entry and new-device acknowledgement, and unrestricted room Area navigation. This repairs existing View/kiosk UX boundaries, not functionality first added during the current beta cycle. Backend ACL and permitted device actions are unchanged; Plan keeps its existing passive draggable icon under owner decision 2B.

summary.ru: Просмотр и киоск не открывают редактор без прав и не снимают флаг нового устройства; переходы к зонам HA больше не предлагаются не-администраторам и киоску.
summary.en: View and kiosk cannot open a forbidden editor or acknowledge a new device; HA Area links are no longer offered to non-admins or kiosk.
